name: Qilin Enabled Linked Connection
description: Detects when the EnableLinkedConnections registry value is set to 1, which shares mapped network drives between standard and elevated processes.
note: Hidden tripwire - no triage here. Triage via the Potential Qilin Staging Activity alert. On its own, this is usually the documented mapped-drive fix or a gold-image bake.
false_positives: Helpdesk/admins applying Microsoft's documented mapped-drive fix (EnableLinkedConnections=1); verify via change ticket or GPO.
query:
host.os.type:"windows" and event.category:"registry" and (event.type:"change" or event.type:"creation") and event.code:("12" or "13") and
(
  registry.path:(*Policies\\System\\EnableLinkedConnections or *CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\EnableLinkedConnections) or
  registry.value:"EnableLinkedConnections"
) and
registry.data.strings:"1" and registry.data.type:"SZ_DWORD"
